description.blurb: 243 Ida is an asteroid in the Koronis family of the asteroid belt, with a mean radius of 15.7 kilometers.
description.more: 243 Ida is the second asteroid visited by a spacecraft and the first found to have its own moon. Its close encounter happened on Aug. 29, 1993 as Galileo flew by at a distance of about 1,500 miles (about 2,400 kilometers) en route to Jupiter. (The spacecraft flew by another asteroid, Gaspra, on Oct. 29, 1991.) A little more than five months later, scientists studying the images Galileo sent back to Earth noticed that a tiny moon accompanied the asteroid, which was named Dactyl.
